title: AI LinkedIn post writer in your voice

source.text: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice, $19 a month. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions.

problem: Writing LinkedIn posts that sound like you takes time
solution: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice
assumptions: Target customer assumed: US B2B founders, consultants and job-seekers who post on LinkedIn weekly
Main paid channel assumed: LinkedIn ads, since no audience was mentioned
Self-serve SaaS with a free trial, built on a third-party LLM API
User said 'just go': no questions asked
